decision: Amend the Class B lane throughput: raise routing.lane.maxInFlight from 1 to 2, keeping maxDispatchesPerRun 1, maxAttempts 2 and cooldownSeconds 3600?
whyItMatters: With maxInFlight 1 the lane advances one debt per verified review, so a backlog drains only as fast as a person closes each item. Raising it trades review load for throughput.
evidence: Code pins maxDispatchesPerRun to exactly 1 and caps maxInFlight at 4; policy can only narrow.
The shared ledger serializes dispatch through a fast-forward-only compare-and-swap; concurrency tests show exactly one lease winner and no duplicate work.
Independent verification is enforced: a verifier verdict from the builder's own agent id is refused.
recommended: Raise maxInFlight to 2 after the first ten /gaia-steward-full runs show zero verifier overturns of accepted work.
alternative: Keep maxInFlight 1 until a quarter of measured closure and no-op rates exists.
unblocks: Two concurrent bounded Class B repairs (builder plus independent verifier each).
